faqs.a:
(a)
All hearings under this article shall be recorded electronically or otherwise. The
               record need not be reduced to a written transcript unless requested by a party tendering
               a transcription fee at a rate set forth in the administrative fee schedule, as approved
               by the city manager.
(b)
Recordings may be destroyed 90 days after the hearing officer's decision is issued
               unless:
(1)
A party, for good cause shown, requests that it be preserved longer; or
(2)
An appeal has been taken from the hearing officer's decision.
(Code 1981, § 2-149; Ord. No. 3608, §§ 1, 2, 4-3-2003)
